रः The spoke or radius of a wheel; अरा इव रथानाभौ
. (˚रम् also); अरैः संधार्यते नाभिर्नाभौ चाराः प्रतिष्ठिताः
. cf. also अरव्यक्तिर्नष्टा स्थितमिव जवाच्चक्रवलयम् Pratima 3.2.
A spoke of the time-wheel; a Jaina division of time.
A corner (कोण) or angle; त्रिपञ्चरे पीठे Śyāmāstava.
N. of an ocean in Brahmā's world; यदरण्यायनमित्याचक्षते ब्रह्मचर्यमेव तत्तदरश्च ह वैण्यश्चार्णवौ ब्रह्मलोके Chān.
. -Comp. -अन्तर (pl.) the intervals of the spoke; चक्रभ्रान्तिररान्तरेषु जनयत्यन्यामिवारावलिम्

a wheel or machine for raising water from a well (Mar. राहाट). (It usually consists of a single wheel with spokes on each side serving as handles to turn it, and a rope with a bucket attached to it passes over this wheel); ˚ट्टं खेलयमानः
turning this machine; ˚घटी a bucket so used; कूपमासाद्य ˚टीमार्गेण सर्पस्तेनानीतः

Sound; दधति दधनि धीरानारवान् वारिणीव Śi.11.8,12.18, नारावं व्यतनुत मेखलाकलापः 8.45. Humming; प्रतिमिलिन्दमारावाः Viś.
N. of a people. -Comp. -डिण्डिमः A kind of drum; चण्डि रसितरशनारवडिण़्डिममभिसर सरसमल़ज्वम्
अरकः [arakḥ], A spoke of a wheel. न नाभिभङ्गे ह्यरका वहन्ति Pt.
अरंकृ [araṅkṛ] गम् [gam], गम् See under अरम् below.
अरंकृ [araṅkṛ], To prepare, make ready, serve; ˚कृत् gratifying, decorating, adorning, serving as a worshipper; ˚कृतिः
अरंगमः [araṅgamḥ], Coming near or into the presence, becoming visible, being present to help; अरंगमाय जग्मये
अरंगम् [araṅgam], To be present, come or go near (to help); become visible, appear.
अरङ्गिन् [araṅgin], a. Passionless; ˚सत्त्वः a passionless being; a class of divinities with Buddhists.
अरंघुष [araṅghuṣa], a. Praising readily, sounding aloud.
अरजस् [arajas] अरज [araja] अरजस्क [arajaska], अरज अरजस्क a.
Not having the monthly courses. f. (-जाः) A young girl who has not reached the age of puberty; a girl before menstruation.
अरज्जु [arajju], a. Not consisting of or furnished with cords; अरज्जौ दस्यून्
अरडा [araḍā], f. N. of a goddess. Gobhil.

Departed, gone away; belonging to others, strange, unusual, foreign; distant, remote (opp. स्व, नित्य or अमा); (Sāy. grieved, sorry दुःखित, अरममाण); inimical, hostile, (with whom one is not on speaking terms).
A refuge; विभेति यस्मादरणं ततो नः
; अरणिः अग्नेर्योनिः] A piece of wood (of the Śamī tree) used for kindling the sacred fire by attrition, the fireproducing wooden stick; प्रयच्छन्ति फलं भूमिररणीव हुताशनम्
. -णी (dual) The two pieces of wood used in kindling the sacred fire. धरण्योर्निहितो जातवेदाः Kaṭha. 4.8.
N. of several fire-producing plants, particularly अग्निमन्थ. -णिः f.
. -Comp. केतुः = अग्निमन्थ Premna Intergrifolia. -सुतः N. of Śuka, a celebrated sage (born from the seed of Vyāsa fallen upon an Araṇi at the sight of the nymph Ghṛitāchī); पितुः पादावगृह्णादरणीसुतः
Fire, agni; चितिं कृत्वा प्रवेक्ष्यामि समिद्धमरणीसुतम्
अरणिमत् [araṇimat], a. Related to the two Araṇis; to be produced by them.
N. of a plant (Mar. बकाणा निंब).
अरण्यम् [araṇyam], (sometimes) m. also, [अर्यते गम्यते शेषे वयसि ऋ-अर्तेर्निच्च
] A land neither cultivated nor grazed, a wilderness, forest, desert; प्रियानाशे कृत्स्नं किल जगदरण्यं हि भवति
; माता यस्य गृहे नास्ति भार्या चाप्रियवादिनी । अरण्यं तेन गन्तव्यं यथारण्यं तथा गृहम् ॥
. oft. used at first member of comp. in the sense of 'wild', 'grown or produced in forest'; ˚बीजम् wild seed; ˚कार्पासि, ˚कुलत्थिका; ˚कुसुम्भः &c.; so ˚मार्जारः, ˚मूषकः.
A foreign or distant land; अरण्येषु जर्भुराणा चरन्ति

. -ण्यः N. of a plant कट्फल (Mar. कायफळ)-Comp. -अध्यक्षः headman or superintendent of a forest district; forest keeper or ranger. -अयनम्, -यानम् going into the forest, becoming a hermit; अथ यदरण्यायनमित्या- चक्षते ब्रह्मचर्यमेव तद् Ch.
dwelling in woods, being in a forest; किंतु ˚सदोवयं अनभ्यस्त रथचर्याः

especially, one who has left his family and become an anchorite, forest-dweller. -कणा wild cumin seed (Mar. जिरें) -कदली wild plantain. -काण्डम् N. of the third book of the Rāmāyaṇa which embodies Rāmā's exploits in the course of his journey through the forests in company with Viśvāmitra. -गजः a wild elephant (not tamed). -गानम् N. of one of the four hymn-books of the Sāmaveda (to be chanted in the forest). -चटकः a wild sparrow. -चन्द्रिका (lit.) moonlight in a forest; (fig.) an ornament or decoration which is useless, or does not serve its purpose; just as moonlight in a forest is useless there being no human beings to view, enjoy and appreciate it, so is decoration when not viewed and appreciated by those for whom it is intended; thus Malli. on स्त्रीणां प्रियालोक- फलो हि वेषः

remarks अन्यथा$रण्यचन्द्रिका स्यादिति भावः. -चर (˚ण्येचर also), -जीव a. wild, living in woods. -ज a. wild; ˚आर्द्रका wild ginger. -जीरम् wild cumin. (Mar. कडू जिरें). -दमनः N. of a plant.-द्वादशी, -व्रतम् N. of a ceremony performed on the 12th day of Mārgaśīrṣa.
धर्मः wild state or usage, wild nature; तथारण्यधर्माद्वियोज्य ग्राम्यधर्मे नियोजितः

the duties of a Vānaprastha or anchorite. -धान्यम्, -शालिः wild rice (नीवार). -नृपतिः, -राज् (ट्), -राजः 'lord of the woods', epithet of a lion or a tiger; so अरण्यानां पतिः. -पण्डितः [अरण्ये एव पण्डितः, न तु नगरादिषु जनसमाजेषु] 'wise in a forest'; (fig.) a foolish person (who can display his learning only in a forest where no one will hear him and correct his errors). -पर्वन् N. of the first section of the Mb. -भव a. growing in a forest, wild; यथा˚ वास्तिलाः

. -मक्षिका a gadfly (Mar. घोडमाशी) -मुद्रकः a kind of wild bean. -यानम् retiring to the woods.-रक्षकः conservator of forests, forest-keeper. -राज्यम् sovereignty of the woods. -रुदितम् (˚ण्ये˚) 'weeping in a forest', a cry in the wilderness; (fig.) a vain or useless speech, or a cry with no one to heed it, or anything done to no purpose; अरण्ये मया रुदितम् Ś.2; प्रोक्तं श्रद्धाविहीनस्य अरण्यरुदितोपमम्
वासः, समाश्रयः retiring into woods, residence in a forest; ˚योन्मुखं पितरम्

a hermitage, forest habitation. -वासिन् a. living in a forest, wild; m. a forest-dweller, an anchorite. (-नी) N. of a plant अत्यम्लपर्णी. -वास्तु (-स्तू)कः N. of a plant वनवेतः. -विलपितम्, -विलापः (˚ण्ये) = ˚रुदितम् above.-श्वन् m. 'a wild hound', wolf. -षष्ठी N. of a festival celebrated on the 6th day of the bright half of Jyeṣṭha. -सभा a forest-court.
अरण्यानिः [araṇyāniḥ] नी [nī], नी f. [अरण्य-आनुक्, ङीप् च;
A large forest, or desert, vast wilderness; यथारण्यान्यामुत्साश्चरन्तः Śat. Br.;
The spirit or presiding deity of the woods and mother of wild animals. उतो अरण्यानिः सायं शकटीरिव सर्जति
A kind of oblation (अरण्ये अनूच्याः पठनीयाः मन्त्रा यस्य).
] Wild sesamum yielding no oil; (fig. anything which does not answer to one's expectation.)
Dissatisfied, discontented, averse to. -तम् Non-copulation. -Comp. -त्रप a. not ashamed of copulation. (-प) a dog (as copulating even in the streets without shame.
Absence of pleasure or amusement; अरतिर्जनसंसदि
. regarded as arising from the longings of love, स्वाभीष्टवस्त्वलाभेन चेतसो या$नवस्थितिः । अरतिः सा S. D.; one of the ten states of love-lorn persons (अनङ्गदशा);
Anxiety, regret, uneasiness, agitation; संधत्ते भृशमरतिं हि सद्वियोगः
अराति [arāti] ति [ti] यति [yati], (ति) यति Den. P. Ved. To desire not to offer; to act like an enemy, act maliciously; अथो यो नो अरातियात्
अरत्निः [aratniḥ], (m. or f.) [ऋ-कत्नि रत्निः स नास्ति यत्र]
The elbow; sometimes the fist itself.

A cubit of the middle length, from the elbow to the tip of the little finger, an ell; अरत्निस्तु निष्कनिष्ठेन मुष्टिना Ak.; मध्याङ्गुलि- कूर्परयोर्मध्ये प्रामाणिकः करः । बद्धमुष्टिकरो रत्निररत्निः स कनिष्ठिकः ॥ Halāy.; A measure 24 Aṅgulas (fingers); एकविंशति- यूपास्ते एकविंशत्यरत्नयः
The arm; अरत्निना चाभिहत्य शिरः कायादपाहरत्
अरथिन् [arathin], a. One who does not fight in a car.
अरथीः [arathīḥ], Ved. Not a charioteer; यमजत्यरथीः
Not lazy, not to be subdued, invincible; अरध्रस्य रध्रतुरो बभूव
अरन्धनम् [arandhanam], Absence of cooking (as on सिंह and कन्या संक्रान्ति).
अरन्ध्र [arandhra], a. Dense, thick; पयोमुच इवारन्ध्राः
अरपचनः [arapacanḥ], A mystical collective name of the 5 Buddhas.
Unhurt, safe. (also अरप); विश्वहारप$- एधते गृहे
Not hurting, sound; salutary, beneficial, शं वातो वात्वरपा अपस्रिधः

आराम [ārāma], a. [रम्-घञ्] Pleasing, delightful; रामभद्र गुणा- राम
A garden, grove; प्रियारामा हि वैदेह्यासीत्
. आरामः कल्पवृक्षाणाम् (रामरक्षा) [cf. Pers. ārām].-Comp. -शीतला N. of a fragrant plant (आनन्दी).
Not pleasing or gratifying, disagreeable, unpleasant.
Obedient, devoted to the worship of God; निकाममरमणसं येन नवन्तमहिं सं पिणगृजीषिन्
; अरमतिः सविता देव आगात् Rv. -तिः f.
Readiness to serve, obedience; devotion to God, hence personified in the Vedas as a Goddess protecting the worshippers of the gods and pious works in general.
अरमिष् [aramiṣ], a. Ved. Going near quickly.
अरमुडिः [aramuḍiḥ], A King of Nepāl; Rāj. T.
Swiftly, near, at hand, present. अरं राजगिरिं याहि पाहि राज्यं निजं नृप Śiva.
Readily, fitly, suitably, so as to answer some purpose.
Enough, sufficiently (cf. अलम्); excessively; पुरु वारं पुरुत्मना
To delight in, take pleasure in, sport; आरमन्तं परं स्मरे
To cease, stop (to speak); leave off; अन्तर्वत्नी त्वहं भ्रात्रा ज्येष्ठेनारम्यतामिति
अररका [ararakā], f. N. of the ancestress of a celebrated Hindu family.
] The leaf or panel of a door (कपाटम्), सरभसमरराणि द्रागपावृत्य
The sheath of a bamboo shoot (करिरकोष).
A covering or sheath in general.
अररिः [arariḥ], The leaf of a door; a door.
A vessel used in preparing Soma; अधारयत् अररिन्दानि सुक्रतुः
Moving (गमनस्वभाव), कं चिद् यावीरररुं शूर मत्यम्
N. of an Asura; अवेद्यमिमीताररुं यश्चतुष्पात्
अररे [ararē], ind. A vocative particle expressive of (1) great haste; (2) contempt or disdain; अररे महाराजं प्रति कुतः क्षत्रियाः G. M.
To try, put to the test.
अरविन्दम् [aravindam], [अरान् चक्राङ्गानीव पत्राणि विन्दते विन्द् श
A lotus (Nymphea Stellata) (it is one of the 5 arrows of Cupid; see under पञ्चबाण); शक्यमरविन्दसुरभिः Ś.3.6. It is a sun lotus; cf. सूर्यंशुभिर्भिन्न- मिवारविन्दम्
Also a red or blue lotus.
Copper. -Comp. -अक्ष a. lotus-eyed, an epithet of Viṣṇu. -दलप्रभम् copper. -नाभिः, -भः N. of Viṣṇu, from whose navel sprang the lotus which supported Brahmā; हृदये मदीये देवश्चकास्तु भगवानरविन्दनाभः
. -सद् m. N. of Brahmā. आनन्दयिष्यदागम्य कथं त्वामर- विन्दसत्

A place abounding in lotus flowers.
Sapless, not juicy, tasteless, insipid; अरसं नित्यमगन्धवच्च यत् Kaṭh.3.15.
Weak, having no strength, inefficacious. वृश्चिकस्यारसं विषमरसं वृश्चिक ते विषम्
One who has no sense of appreciation. किमस्या नाम स्यादरसपुरुषानादरशतैः । N.
Unhappy. कृपणं वत यज्जनः स्वयं सन्नरसो व्याधिजरा- विनाशधर्मा Bu. ch.5.12. -सः No juice, absence of juice.
Devoid of taste, sapless, insipid, flavourless (of a thing).
Void of feeling or taste, dull, unfeeling, inappreciative, insensible to the charms (of poetry &c.); अरसिकेषु कवित्वनिवेदनं शिरसि मा लिख मा लिख मा लिख Udb.
अरसीठक्कुरः [arasīṭhakkurḥ], N. of a poet (mentioned in Śārṅgadhara's anthology).
अरहायते [arahāyatē], Den. A. To become known.
अराग [arāga] अरागिन् [arāgin], अरागिन् a. Cool, dispassionate; तमहमरागकृष्णं कृष्णद्वैपायनं वन्दे

; अराजके जीवलोके दुर्बला बलवत्तरैः । पीड्यन्ते न हि वित्तेषु प्रभुत्वं कस्यचित्तदा ॥ Mb.; शोच्यं राज्यमराजकम्

अराजिन् [arājin], a. Ved. Unchecked, unrestrained, or without splendour; पर्वताँ अराजिनः

An enemy, foe; देशः सो$यमरातिशोणितजलैर्यस्मिन् ह्रदाः पूरिताः

. (in the Veda) non-offering (of sacrifices), stinginess, hardness, malignity, malevolence, failure or adversity; malignity personified; evil spirit whose aim it was to defeat the good intentions and disturb the happiness of man (used in f.).
The sixth position in (astronomy). -Comp. -दूषण, -दूषि, -ह a. Ved/ destroying adversities or enemies;
Waving lights before an image (Mar. आरती).

Near, in the vicinity of; (with abl. or by itself); तमर्च्यमारादभिवर्तमानम्
Far from; with acc. also in both these senses; Śi.3.31,8.29, कथंचिदारा- दपथेन निन्यिरे 12.28; to a distant place, distant.
Far, from a distance; मेघमालेव यश्यायमारादिव विभाव्यते

Stingy, niggardly.-यः, -यी Any malignant or evil spirit; अरायि काणे विकटे
